desc: Welcome to 35-45 May Street, New Rochelle's choice for classic, spacious, elevator apartments. Professionally owner-managed, our apartment homes will meet all your needs: comfort, convenience, and location. May Street is a quiet lane near the intersection of Lockwood and North Avenues, around the corner from Sound Shore Medical Center, one mile from Iona College and a short walk to the Metro North Railroad, which will bring you to Manhattan's Grand Central Station in under 30 minutes! Our beautifully renovated apartment homes feature hardwood floors, spacious layouts, and eat-in kitchens with solid oak cabinets. Higher floor units in this elevator building offer expansive views and great light. Our professional management team and on-site maintenance staff will keep your apartment in tip-top shape. We look forward to seeing you at 35-45 May!

desc: The Huguenot is a new property located in the heart of downtown New Rochelle that doesn't nickel and dime its residents! Offering spacious studio, 1 bedroom, and 2 bedroom apartments that are designed with modern living in mind, each apartment is elegantly finished with hardwood floors, a full suite of Blomberg stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and in-unit washer/dryers. Amenities include a rooftop terrace, lounge spaces, fitness room with Echelon connected equipment, and secure package locker system. Pets are welcome and will appreciate the pet spa and rooftop dog run. The Huguenot is just a few blocks from Metro North and Amtrak, and is ideally positioned for residents seeking a modern apartment, with ease of access to all that this vibrant city has to offer.

desc:
Welcome to The Atelier, an exquisite affordable new development in the heart of charming New Rochelle. The Atelier offers all the amenities of modern living within a quaint and historic setting that has historically been home to a significant number of prominent 20th-century illustrators. Inquire today and discover high-quality, affordable housing crafted to inspire your journey.

 

The Atelier is part of Westchester Place, three buildings totaling 524 units in downtown New Rochelle. The community provides bespoke housing at affordable rates, art galleries and studios (including a communal studio free of charge) and thousands of square feet of art related event spaces.

desc:
Discover elevated living at Alary, where modern luxury meets everyday convenience in the heart of New Rochelle, Westchester County NY. Designed for today's lifestyle, Alary offers thoughtfully crafted studio, one-, and two-bedroom residences featuring spacious layouts, contemporary finishes, oversized windows, in-home washer and dryer, and designer kitchens with stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops.

Enjoy an exceptional collection of resort-inspired amenities, including a rooftop pool and sundeck with grilling stations, state-of-the-art fitness center, resident lounge, coworking spaces, pet-friendly amenities, valet parking, concierge service, and beautifully designed common areas that make coming home feel like a retreat.

Located just minutes from Metro-North, Alary offers a quick commute to Manhattan while placing you steps from New Rochelle's vibrant dining, shopping, waterfront, and entertainment destinations.

Experience luxury, comfort, and convenience all in one place. Schedule your tour today and see why residents love calling Alary home.
